abstract: Maintains pavement axle bearing capacities and night travel curfew waivers
system_message:
You are Pavement and roadway engineer (PRE). The Pavement and roadway engineer (PRE) maintains civil infrastructure records, including pavement structural bearing capacities, night transit curfew authorizations, and culvert drainage maintenance evaluations across heavy-haul highway routes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Culvert drainage maintenance（DRN）
information_points.content:
PRE-DRN-O9L：According to the drainage culvert inspection log for the Ridge Foothills Heavy Truck Route, cross-drainage structures under the highway alignment maintain a culvert sediment clearance ratio of 95% of design intake cross-sectional area.
PRE-DRN-GBZ：According to the drainage culvert inspection log for the Valley Expressway Freight Arterial, cross-drainage structures along the highway alignment have a culvert sediment clearance ratio of 70% of design intake cross-sectional area.
PRE-DRN-OWM：According to the drainage culvert inspection log for the Coastal Parkway South Bypass Corridor, cross-drainage structures beneath the highway alignment exhibit a culvert sediment clearance ratio of 85% of design intake cross-sectional area.

information_points.title: Maintains pavement axle bearing capacities and night travel curfew waivers（PVMT）
information_points.content:
PRE-PVMT-0N1：For the Ridge Foothills Heavy Truck Route, deflectometer evaluation at the weakest highway pavement subgrade section shows a pavement bearing capacity of 135 kN dynamic single-axle vertical load, while a night transit window is permitted through municipal curfew approvals for transit between 00:00 and 05:00.
PRE-PVMT-3TC：For the Valley Expressway Freight Arterial, falling weight deflectometer structural testing on the weakest subgrade cross-section indicates a pavement bearing capacity of 155 kN dynamic single-axle vertical load, and a night transit window is permitted with unanimous municipal authorization for transit between 00:00 and 05:00.
PRE-PVMT-X41：For the Coastal Parkway South Bypass Corridor, structural evaluation via falling weight deflectometer on the weakest highway pavement subgrade cross-section establishes a pavement bearing capacity of 155 kN maximum permissible dynamic single-axle vertical load, and a night transit window is permitted based on unanimous municipal curfew waivers for convoy transit between 00:00 and 05:00.
